[Commits to Master Since This Release](https://github.com/SabeeirSharrma/CinderBlock/compare/%version%...master)

#### How to Install:

- **Chromium**: Download the \`cinderblock.chromium_%version%.zip\` from the release assets, unzip, and load unpacked in \`chrome://extensions/\` (Developer mode)
- **Firefox**: Download the \`cinderblock.firefox_%version%.xpi\` from the release assets and drag into Firefox
